description: Review supplied actual whole-organism20ms timings and code to advise whether to start a stage3 biological campaign or first repair pipeline and measure why CNS trials stop. Speed target1s/60s remains unmet; a partial verifier omitted spatial voltages and body velocities. This is a recommendation for a qualified reviewer, not a scientific vote by a router.

Implement local repairs: explicit current CUDA engine selection, event boundaries, exclusive output ownership, interruption receipts, operator binding identity and partial-publication failure handling. Verify with corruption fixtures and bounded real smoke without changing numerical limits.

Reason about three alternatives using measured bottlenecks: causal event-dependency partition, nonlinear receiver response integration with error control, or a new full operator runtime if neither partition strategy is justified. First distinguish causes of substep cuts in one real accepted epoch; do not extrapolate synthetic benchmarks.
